acceptance-tests.md's Positive-capability matrix row 'G3: validator が正当な契約を誤検知しない' cites, in its '正例 AC' (positive-AC) column: 'AC-003, AC-004, AC-005, AC-025, AC-026, AC-018 の境界正例' (line 54). AC-018's own Test Type in the AC table is 'negative fixture (pattern 違反)' (line 27), not a positive criterion. The same matrix's preamble explicitly bars this: '負例 AC はここでは根拠にならない（違反が拒否されることは、正用が通ることを含意しない）' (lines 41-42), repeated in the 充足規則 as '負例 AC は根拠にならない。違反が拒否されることは、正用が受理されることを含意しない' (line 66). Compounding this, AC-018's Test Target states the boundary values are shown accepted 'AC-003 の正例 fixture 系で受理される' (line 27), but the document's own Notes section instead attributes them to 'TEST-018 の境界正例（`APIOrder` / `order-taking-2`）' (line 143) — a direct location contradiction as to which suite entry (TEST-003 or TEST-018) actually carries the fixture proving this. Neither location gives these two positive fixtures the explicit 'N fixture — (1)(2)...' enumeration used for every other multi-part item in this document (contrast AC-018's own '3 fixture で個別に証明する' for its negative content at the same line, or AC-017/019/020/021/022/023/024's identical enumeration convention). AC-003's own Test Target (line 12) never mentions `APIOrder` or `order-taking-2`, so nothing currently obligates AC-003's fixture to carry them. Downstream failure mode: a task author implementing TEST-018/TEST-003 has no single authoritative instruction for how many boundary-positive fixtures exist or where they live, so this specific pattern-non-over-rejection claim risks going unimplemented while the matrix still records it as proven. This is a specification-level ambiguity in acceptance-tests.md's own cross-reference structure (not an implementation-review or task-decomposition matter), and it violates the matrix's own stated eligibility rule for the '正例 AC' column, which is why it is Major rather than a best-practice nicety.

requirements.md's Non-goals section explicitly excludes 7 adjacent surfaces (concept-test skill/bootstrap, concept-model.template.md/interviewer stage changes, reviewer A/B checks, reverse mode/C4, v1->v2 migration tooling/dual-version loader 'owner 決定により恒久的にスコープ外', domain/ Markdown artifact generation, and mechanical enforcement of meta.status Approved). Roles and Permissions further states explicitly that approval-mechanism creation is out of scope: '承認強制機構の新設は本 feature の非目標であり、必要と判断された場合は別 feature として起票する' (line 201-202). Edge Cases bound concepts=[] as invalid and single-vs-cross-context name collision behavior explicitly. No open-ended expansion surface is left unaddressed.

Material constraints are explicit: compatibility/migration ('v1 資産は存在しないものとして扱い...v1 → v2 のアーティファクト移行設計・二重バージョンローダーは作らない', line 26-28, and REQ-007's byte-identical guarantee), security (Security Boundaries section: content-as-data, no network access, no external deps beyond python3 stdlib json / ConvertFrom-Json, no secrets in fixtures), and approval boundary (Roles and Permissions: 'meta.status の Approved 書込に対する機械的強制は存在しない...承認境界は人間のレビュー運用のみが担保', line 196-200, grounded in investigation.md INV-008). Assumptions section also records and bounds a process deviation (hook-activation CAPABILITY_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE) with an explicit forward constraint: 'spec-review 以降のゲートは hook 有効環境で実行すること' (line 244).

All three declared risks carry an explicit validation surface: R1 (concepts[] type insufficiency) -> 'fixture corpus を先に書き、Phase 1 の判定4種...が必要とするフィールドを受け入れテストで先取り検証する'; R2 (validator/schema drift) -> 'REQ-006 のテストが schema ファイルの required/pattern 宣言と validator の挙動を同一 fixture で突き合わせる'; R3 (sh/ps1 twin mismatch) -> 'REQ-006 の twin parity 検査（同一 fixture・同一 verdict）', concretely realized as AC-013. No high-risk claim in this spec lacks a named acceptance-criterion or fixture-based validation path.
